title: Time Jump — 07:15, Level 2 Activation

fields.narration: Time jump. It is now 07:15 on Saturday, March 14, 2026. The Hospital Crisis Command (HCC) has been open for 50 minutes at Level 2 activation. Outpatient dialysis remains on hold. Facilities has completed the first conservation round, reducing non-essential water use by 30%. The two inpatients with potassium above 6.0 are being managed with temporizing treatment and close monitoring. The city has not issued a time for lifting the advisory.
worldState: The HCC has been open for 50 minutes at Level 2 activation.

fields.scenarioTitle: Water Line, No Drink — A Regional Water Advisory That Reaches Dialysis

instructorNote: This time jump advances the timeline to the start of the second operational period. The team must now set objectives for the next four-hour period, including decisions on dialysis continuity, patient movement, and communication to staff and families.
